title: Founder Idea-to-PRD Productization
goal: Productize the founder idea-to-PRD workflow into governed intake, Q&A, feasibility framing, PRD readiness, and agent handoff planning before any live execution is admitted.
safetyRules: P133.1 is contract/checker/docs/status only.

Do not execute founder Q&A, call providers/models, generate PRDs with providers/models, dispatch agents, create or mutate projects, write DB/runtime state, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.
Do not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw table names, raw report paths, private IDs, or fake runnable actions in primary UX.
Do not modify project-owned files.
reuseCheck: Reuse existing founder-intake and business-build domain boundaries as references only.
Reuse existing enterprise roadmap and OS phase status checker patterns.
Do not duplicate report writers, checker formatters, mode guards, redaction helpers, route matrices, status helpers, UI components, or evidence/audit/activity appenders.
commandCenterUx: P133.1 preserves existing founder-facing Command Center pages, repairs route-wide safety copy/test drift, and does not add P133 feature controls. P133.4 will own future scoped UX changes.
costImpact: No provider calls, model calls, network calls, runtime execution, DB writes, deploy/package creation, or provider spend.

subphases.title: Intake and PRD Model
subphases.narrowGoal: Define the deterministic founder intake and PRD model for structured Q&A, feasibility, readiness, blockers, evidence, and safe local state.
subphases.dataShape: Result envelope for deterministic local founder idea-to-PRD readiness: schemaVersion, currentState, modelMode, intake summary, question state, comprehension score, PRD readiness fields, feasibility signals, localState safety booleans, allowed local operations, forbidden operations, safetyFlags, blockers, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, and Command Center visibility. No DB schema, migration, provider envelope, agent dispatch packet, project data, raw private ID, raw report dump, or live execution.
